messages:
Sam: Noticed a mismatch in the API reference for POST /v1/rerank — examples use `candidates: string` and return `top_candidate` as a string. OpenAPI defines `candidates: array[string]` and response should include `rankings: [{index: int, score: float}]`. I opened a tiny PR to fix examples: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912
Iris: thanks for flagging. Which files are impacted?
Sam: docs/reference/rerank.md, docs/_snippets/python/rerank.md, and openapi/rerank.yaml (example block). Also the curl snippet shows `Content-Type: text/plain` for a JSON body.
DocsBot: lint: openapi/rerank.yaml: requestBody.example does not match schema (expected array for candidates). docs/_snippets/python/rerank.md: doctest failed - response parsing expects string top_candidate.
Ben: Quick proposal: canonical request shape should be `{ "model_id": "redwood-rank-1", "query": "...", "candidates": ["a","b","c"] }`. Response example should be `{ "object":"ranking", "rankings":[{"index":0,"score":0.92},{"index":2,"score":0.45}], "usage":{ "total_tokens":0 } }`.
Iris: Agreed. Also add a small migration note: server still accepts single-string `candidates` for backward compatibility but docs should show array. Keep it brief and put it under the changes section.
Sam: I'll update the OpenAPI example and the Python snippet. For the python snippet change from `top = resp['top_candidate']` to `top = resp['rankings'][0]['index']` (and then pick candidate by index). Will push in the PR.
DocsBot: PR #912: checks queued -> https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/2418. lint: curl-snippets: Content-Type mismatch found in docs/reference/rerank.md.
Ben: I'll fix the curl snippet to use `-H 'Content-Type: application/json'` and keep the inline JSON single-line for brevity in curl. Also add a short example showing how to extract ordered candidates from the response.
QA-Bot: sample-test: rerank-snippet.py executed against mocked server -> failed (expected rankings key). Adding a unit test to confirm example output shape will help prevent regressions.
Iris: Good call. Add the unit test to docs CI (tests/snippets/test_rerank.py). Sam/Bob: when you push, please run `make docs-validate` locally.
Sam: pushed changes to PR 912 with OpenAPI + snippets + CI test. PTAL.
Ben: LGTM, CI green. Merging now and redeploying docs staging.
DocsBot: PR #912 merged. Docs build triggered -> https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/2421. Sam: closing thread after staging verifies render. :shipit:
